adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `save()` action sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) defaults a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. However, after `host.save(props)` resolves, the client unconditionally overwrites the model with `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`; if `categoryId` is null/undefined (e.g., for a new host where no category was chosen), `findById` returns nothing and the UI will show a blank badge even though the persisted `category_id` is uncategorized until reload.
